data.one_liner: iOS/macOS implementation of path_provider using direct FFI calls
data.what_it_does: Provides platform-specific directories such as application documents, cache, temporary, and support directories for iOS and macOS. It replaces the older Flutter‑plugin based implementation with direct Foundation calls.
use_when: You need file system paths on iOS or macOS
You are using the path_provider plugin and want the native implementation
avoid_when: You are already using path_provider and do not import this package directly
strengths: Direct FFI for potentially better performance

alternatives.name: path_provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a unified API for all platforms and automatically includes this implementation when used
